title: Fix a leaking kitchen tap
description: Single-lever mixer that drips constantly. Washer and tools needed. A 20-minute job for someone who knows what they're doing.

title: Sit with my dad for two hours and talk cricket
description: He's 78, sharp as ever, and lonely on weekday evenings. No caregiving, just company and a good argument about the 1983 World Cup.

title: Haircut at home before a wedding
description: Need a clean fade and beard trim. I have a chair, a mirror, and good light. Saturday morning, before the chaos starts.

title: Set up a new router and my smart TV
description: Airtel fibre box, a Fire Stick, and a TV that refuses to find the Wi-Fi. Bring patience and your own ladder if you have one.

title: Deep clean a 2BHK after a house party
description: Kitchen, two bathrooms, floors, and the balcony. Supplies are at home. Should take around three hours with two people.

title: Teach me Class 10 trigonometry
description: Two sessions a week. I keep confusing sine and cosine, and board exams are in March. Online is fine, in person is better.

title: Pick up medicine and a short grocery list
description: Two prescriptions waiting at Apollo and a list of six things. I'll pay for everything in advance. Just need it before dinner.

title: One hour of boxing pad work
description: I have gloves and pads. You just need to hold them and shout at me. Former boxers especially welcome. No experience necessary.

title: Assemble a study desk from IKEA
description: Six boxes, one Allen key, and a person who actually enjoys diagrams. I'll make chai and stay out of the way.
helperNote: I've built three of these. I'll bring my own drill.

title: Walk my dog while I'm stuck in a meeting
description: Bruno is a very good boy. Thirty minutes around the park, twice. He pulls a little when he sees other dogs.
helperNote: I live two streets away and know the park.

title: Fix a wobbly ceiling fan
description: It sounds like a helicopter at speed three. I have a stool and a healthy fear of heights.
helperNote: Balanced the blades and tightened the mount. Ten minutes.
